conviction_note: The things this full-year print could add were mostly said in public on 2026-07-28: FY26 operating profit landing above the 1,470m plan, an FY27 guide of +40% operating profit, and a medium-term plan raised from +30% to +40%. So the headline guide is not new. What is left is the setup: the margin long is crowded with no short side, this name fell on each of its last four prints, including -11.6% on last year's +41% guide, and the per-share and ordinary lines will lag the operating headline. That gives a small negative lean (p_up 45) on a 6.5% scale. The findings sum to -0.8 and the scaled number is -0.65; the two agree in sign and roughly in size.
bar: Company FY2026/9 forecast, unchanged since 2025-10-28 and reaffirmed in the Q3 短信: sales 10,500m, operating profit 1,470m, ordinary profit 1,117m, net profit 725m, dividend 0 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/55320/081220260728500659_tse-qnedjpsm-55320-20260728355320-ixbrl.htm). On 2026-07-28 the company said FY26 operating profit would land above plan and FY27 would grow operating profit +40% from that landing (https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/385250). No IFIS consensus exists (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=5532, blank) and I could not reach 四季報, so the company's own pre-guide is the bar and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0%, no disclosed seller, unchanged (baseline, as of 20261026). The stock is 制度信用 buy-only, so there is no margin short side at all. Margin long balance 390.5k shares on 10/23, up from 370.1k on 9/25 and 377.7k on 10/02 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=5532). That is about 6% of the 6.50m shares outstanding and about 20-25 sessions of normal turnover (median ¥55.8m a day, roughly 15-18k shares). 信用倍率 is undefined because the short side is zero. No option skew exists. Reading: a crowded leveraged long with nothing to squeeze.

findings.finding: The FY27 guide and the medium-term-plan upgrade were pre-announced. At the Q3 call on 2026-07-28 the CEO said FY26 operating profit would land above the 1,470m plan, that next year's plan has a line of sight to +40% operating-profit growth from that landing, and that the medium-term plan would be raised from +30% to +40% at year end. Two FY27 inputs have been added since: AMBRE was reclassified to inventory for an FY27 sale (9/30), and a ¥1.5bn Sendagaya property was bought for January 2027 delivery, its FY27 effect to be disclosed with this 短信 (10/22). Together these make a guide at or slightly above +40% (operating profit around 2.06-2.2bn) the likely print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's full-year print (released 2025-10-28 15:30) carried a +40.9% operating-profit guide and the new 中期経営計画2028; the stock moved -11.59% close to close (3330 to 2944, Yahoo daily bars). The Q3 print that pre-announced the +40% FY27 growth moved -9.65% (3575 to 3230).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It is a public company statement, and the stock fell on the day it was made. The only unpriced part is whether the guide clears +40% because of the AMBRE sale and the new acquisition, both disclosed after the statement. If the market expected well above +40%, the stock would have re-rated after the 10/22 and 10/26 disclosures; instead it has traded flat at 3,300-3,700 since April.
findings.independence: AMBRE reclassification for an FY27 sale: https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260930542893.pdf. ¥1.5bn acquisition, FY27 effect to come with the 短信: https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261022554569.pdf. Both are separate primary documents from the call transcript.

findings.finding: FY26 actual is pre-signalled at or slightly above plan. 9M operating profit was 1,160m (79% of plan) and ordinary 870m (77.9%), so Q4 needs about 310m operating and 247m ordinary. Q4 carries one planned sale and two handovers, including the 目黒区大橋 new-build building sale scheduled for Jun-Aug 2026. On 10/22, after the year closed, the company again stated no change to the FY26 forecast, which keeps the outturn inside the TSE ±30% profit band.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name sold the last two quarters, where the quarter landed on plan: Q1 FY26 ordinary profit up 4.5x moved -8.00%, and Q3 moved -9.65% on a 4-6 month loss inside an unchanged plan.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The company has said 'above plan' and the 10/22 notice reaffirmed the forecast, so anyone holding the stock knows the year is on plan. The 進捗率 (77.9% against 97-102% at the same point in prior years) is visible to anyone, and the Q4 sale explains the gap.
findings.independence: Q4 sale schedule: https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/55320/140120240829578107.pdf (2024-08-29, building handover Jun-Aug 2026, FY26). Reaffirmation: https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261022554569.pdf.

findings.finding: A crowded margin long with no short side into a print this name has sold four times running. Margin buying stands at 390.5k shares (about 6% of shares outstanding, about 3 weeks of turnover) and has been building since September, against zero margin shorts (buy-only issue) and zero disclosed shorts. The last four real-date reactions were -11.59%, -8.00%, -2.34% and -9.65%.
findings.why_not_priced: The balance is public weekly, so it is partly priced. If leveraged holders had already de-risked into the print, the balance would be falling; it rose from 370k to 390k shares over four weeks. A crowded margin long is the one setup in which a pre-known, on-plan print still has sellers.
findings.independence: Reaction history from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/5532.T?range=2y&interval=1d (a different source from the margin data). Last year's guide-day fall of -11.6% is in the same series.

findings.finding: Per-share and ordinary growth will trail the operating headline. Shares outstanding rose from 5.75m to 6.49m (+13%) with the June public offering and the Hulic allotment, and 9M ordinary profit grew only +3.0% (net -1.9%) against +18.5% for operating profit, as financing costs widened (interest expense was a Q3 Q&A topic). A +40% operating guide may therefore read as roughly +20-25% EPS growth, and kabutan's headline is written on ordinary profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the FY25 print the guide was +40.9% operating, +35.1% ordinary and +13.8% EPS (kabutan finance table), and the stock fell 11.59%. This is suggestive but not separable from the run-in.
findings.why_not_priced: The share count and the ordinary/operating gap are computable from the Q3 短信, so this is partly priced. The release adds the FY27 ordinary, net and EPS guide, which nobody has seen. Had the market already capitalised a diluted EPS path, the stock would not sit at about 31x trailing PER on the headline operating story.
findings.independence: Kabutan financials (ordinary/operating gap by quarter, FY26 guide EPS 111.7): https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=5532. Same underlying filings, so it is one document family.

findings.finding: Hulic JV: the first hotel (SHIFT HOTEL GINZA, spring 2028) was announced 10/26 noon, with a JV investment-balance target above ¥100bn. The stock opened 10/27 at 3,595, touched 3,720 and was back at 3,500 by 10:00.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Hulic alliance announcement (2026-02-03) and the third-party allotment (May) preceded the Q2 and Q3 prints, both of which fell.
findings.why_not_priced: Priced: the tape already traded it this morning and faded it. Filed for completeness, because the 決算説明資料 may quantify the JV's contribution to FY27.

outside_window.finding: AMBRE (Sendagaya 3-chome), reclassified to inventory, is targeted for sale in FY27. It gives flow profit when sold, not at this print except through the guide (counted in finding 1).
MTP target of operating profit 2.5bn in FY28 and 5bn brought forward from FY31. The multi-year path resolves well after the window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none expected for FY26 (reaffirmed 10/22; company says operating profit lands above 1,470m). Returns: none expected, dividend 0, growth-investment policy. New-year guide: the main item, pre-announced as +40% operating profit from the FY26 landing plus a medium-term-plan upgrade from 30% to 40%; the risk is ordinary/EPS trailing it because of a 13% larger share count and interest. Quarter vs own 進捗率: 9M ordinary 77.9% against 97-102% in prior years, explained by the planned Q4 sale; visible and priced.
baseline_tension: The baseline lean is a slight +0.17 from a flat 20-day run-up (-3.4%), with a +7.7% 5-day run-in and no short interest. My net lean is mildly negative and rests on the margin crowding and this name's record of selling its prints, not on a visible miss. The strongest positive the release could carry is an FY27 guide clearly above +40% (helped by the AMBRE sale and the new acquisition) together with the formal medium-term-plan upgrade. I looked for a dividend initiation and found no sign of one. A guide well above 2.2bn operating profit would flip this.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the dilution/interest finding rests on numbers computable from the last 短信, so I cut it from -0.7 to -0.4 (the release still adds the unseen FY27 ordinary/EPS guide, so it is not zero).

Rule 2 and open question 4: my set leaned negative, so I wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension. The margin-crowding finding sits beside a +7.7% five-day run-in, which echoes the one case that rose 8%, so I trimmed it from -1.5 to -1.2 and moved p_up from 43 to 45. Expected move goes from -0.91 to -0.65.
Left standing: the guidance and FY26-actual findings (already sized toward 0 as pre-announced), the Hulic item, the abs_move of 6.5 and the 15:30 window.
